title: Finite affine comparison Cech cocycles descend to etale Cech complexes
statement: Let Y be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], J any abelian sheaf on Y_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and F its comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let V be an affine ind-etale Y-object and U_i -> V a finite pro-etale covering indexed by Fin n whose nonempty repeated intersections are affine ind-etale Y-objects [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis]. For every natural q and every degree q+1 cocycle c in the ordered Cech complex of F [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], there exist an object W of Y_et, a covering family T_i -> W indexed by ULift(Fin n), a morphism phi from its categorical Cech complex with coefficients J to the original ordered complex, and a degree q+1 cocycle c_prime in the source such that phi(c_prime)=c. No injectivity, vanishing or coboundary is asserted. The empty family and empty schemes are included.

source.place: Tag 099U, condition (3), the two finite Cech limit reductions before applying injectivity; Tags 099T, 01ZM, 01ZN, 07RP; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/099U

proof.text: Use singleton-product isomorphisms and the geometric presentation theorem to construct a common small cofiltered affine étale Čech system, with covering stage families and scheme-limit nerve cones.

Apply finite-coordinate section continuity and eventual zero to lift the original degree q+1 cocycle to a cocycle at one covering stage. Its image under the canonical comparison complex map is the original cocycle.

Use the categorical/ordered ULift complex isomorphism, compose its forward map with the stage comparison map, and transport the stage cocycle by its inverse. Inverse equations give the required image equality; the chain-map equation gives the cocycle equation. Reindexing does not change the generated covering sieve.

proof_origin.place: Tag 099U; finite-disjoint-union and surjection presentations, wide-pullback limit construction, coefficient continuity, finite representatives and eventual zero, and ULift product comparison; all proved in this delivery

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_cech_cocycle_lift
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y]
    (J : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (V : Y.ProEt) (hV : proAffineEtale V.hom)
    {n : ℕ} (U : Fin n → Over V)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n),
      proAffineEtale (Presheaf.cechNerveObj U y).left.hom)
    (hcover : Sieve.ofArrows (fun a ↦ (U a).left) (fun a ↦ (U a).hom) ∈
      Scheme.ProEt.topology Y V) (q : ℕ)
    (c : ((Presheaf.cechComplex U).obj
      ((comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Y).obj J).obj).X (q + 1))
    (hc : ((Presheaf.cechComplex U).obj
      ((comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Y).obj J).obj).d (q + 1) (q + 2) c = 0) :
    ∃ (W : Y.Etale) (T : ULift.{u + 1} (Fin n) → Y.Etale)
      (f : ∀ i, T i ⟶ W),
      Sieve.ofArrows T f ∈ Y.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
      ∃ (φ : (cechComplexFunctor fun i ↦ Over.mk (f i)).obj
          ((Over.forget W).op ⋙ J.obj) ⟶
        (Presheaf.cechComplex U).obj
          ((comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Y).obj J).obj)
        (c' : ((cechComplexFunctor fun i ↦ Over.mk (f i)).obj
          ((Over.forget W).op ⋙ J.obj)).X (q + 1)),
        ((cechComplexFunctor fun i ↦ Over.mk (f i)).obj
          ((Over.forget W).op ⋙ J.obj)).d (q + 1) (q + 2) c' = 0 ∧
          φ.f (q + 1) c' = c
